The main takeaway from our work is that
RNNs can have a much smaller network size than previously thought, provided that the input streams have some structure.
RNNs can be effective for time-vary data processing tasks with multidimensional input, provided the input has low-dimensional structure.
the STM capacity of linear ESNs is not fundamentally limited by input dimension, but rather by the dimensionality of the input structure.
